{{Quote|On a planet as miserable as ''this'' one&hellip;that Imperial fort we almost collided with can't be anything more than a ''training outpost!''|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="It's a Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Training Center''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] fort stationed on the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Orlok]] was in charge of the facility.
